line: Bitcoin retreats with ETF outflows and fear sentiment elevated; institutional infrastructure builds out across custody and stablecoin rails.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin -1.94% on the day, spot ETF net -299.8M USD (Nov 11, 2026), Fear & Greed 28 (fear), funding +0.0073% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: Nvidia stock fell after New York Times reported CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with internal executive Kimberly Powell, escalating governance concerns.
Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, BBVA commit $270M to Project Faro, a US dollar stablecoin venture targeting first-half 2027 launch.
Deutsche Bank switched on digital asset custody service for institutional and corporate clients in Europe, holding Bitcoin, Ethereum, and select stablecoins.
